Each of the statements A to D describes a structure found in eukaryotic cells.
Identify the structure that is described in each statement.
A An organelle that contains 70S ribosomes.
B A thread-like structure composed of DNA and histone proteins.
C The organelle that modifies and packages proteins for secretion.
D The structure that synthesises rRNA and combines it with proteins.

Describe the way in which cholera is transmitted from an infected person to an uninfected
person.

Gangliosides are glycolipids that bind choleragen. These glycolipids are found on many cell
surface membranes.
When choleragen is released from the bacteria in the intestine, it binds to gangliosides on epithelial
cells and enters these cells as shown in Fig. 6.1.

parts.text:
Name the process by which choleragen enters the intestinal epithelial cell as shown in
Fig. 6.1.

Once inside the cells choleragen is activated. One effect is to increase the movement of chloride
ions through channel proteins out of cells.

chloride ions through the channel proteins.

Health authorities recommend that antibiotics, such as tetracycline, are only to be used for
treating people with severe cases of cholera.

of cholera or to protect people from cholera.
